title: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed this 8-K on April 29, 2026, announcing that no redemption requests were received from holders of redeemable Class A ordinary shares ahead of the anticipated business combination with Boost Run Holdings, LLC. The company is listed on Nasdaq (tickers: WLACU, WLAC, WLACW). This is a routine corporate SEC filing related to a SPAC merger and has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. is a Cayman Islands exempted company and SPAC operating under SEC rules as an emerging growth company.
The company is listed on Nasdaq with three securities: units (WLACU), Class A ordinary shares (WLAC), and warrants exercisable at $11.50 per share (WLACW).
No redemption requests were received from shareholders before the deadline in connection with the proposed business combination with Boost Run Holdings, LLC.
This is a routine corporate disclosure under Item 8.01 Other Events, filed pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
